rubrics.justification: The response gives a plausible Day-4 morula/early cavitation interpretation, but it fabricates several fine details not reliably assessable from a single image (exact fragmentation %, excluded cells, cytoplasmic granularity, early cavity) and uses blastocyst-oriented descriptors without clear visible support.

It integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor, prior miscarriage, semen parameters, and endometrial thickness well with embryo quality, though some assumptions (e.g., proven receptivity, no implantation concerns) are somewhat overstated.

The reasoning is generally structured and internally consistent, with a logical link between moderate morphology and favorable patient factors; minor issues include speculative quantitative adjustments and some overinterpretation of lifestyle effects.

Much of the counseling is broadly reasonable, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based for this scenario (routine aspirin, progesterone augmentation for prior miscarriage, thrombophilia/NK-cell testing, ERA mention, and assuming trilaminar endometrium).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and future planning, including culture extension and recurrent loss workup thresholds, though some suggestions are more speculative than evidence-based.
